|lore=A native of Esseles. Resigned from Esselian defense force after the Imperial Senate was disbanded. Senior deck officer of Echo Base responsible for docking bay operations.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at a docking bay, power and defense value +2. Tamizander Rey’s docking bay transit requires -3 Force.
|printings={{Card versions/Tamizander Rey (Hoth)}}
|notes=The 2006 slip describes the reduction as Tamizander Rey’s docking bay transit cost. The [[Tamizander Rey (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the exact release PDF created on 4 February 2003. The sheet gives 5 February as the sanctioned legality date. The [[Tamizander Rey (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=60 Period group docking transit rule, p. 60].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 18. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
